title: PyMaster (NaMaster) cross-check of the in-house spin-0 MASTER estimator used by the P1B blind test, plus S6 effective-multipole shortcut error vs NaMaster

inputs.name: Alonso, Sanchez, Slosar et al. 2019 - NaMaster: a unified pseudo-Cl framework

environment.python: python3.11.16 (conda-forge, throwaway micromamba env pymaster_env) + numpy 2.4.6 + healpy 1.20.0 + namaster/pymaster 3.0.1
environment.hardware: cpu-only; Apple M-series MacBook Air, macOS 25.5.0 arm64 (Houstons-MacBook-Air.local)

reproduction.est_wall_clock: ~1 min including one-time conda-forge namaster env creation (~2-4 min)
reproduction.notes: Homebrew pip has no macOS/arm64 pymaster wheel for Python 3.14 and the source build needs a working C toolchain plus GSL/FFTW/CFITSIO/HEALPix; conda-forge's namaster package ships prebuilt and is the reliable path. Deterministic: fixed seeds (mask_seed=11, map_seed=42), no external data or network calls beyond the one-time package install.

verification: Re-run and confirm: (a) coupling_matrix.max_rel_diff <= 1e-11 (measured 4.25e-13) over l=2..95, i.e. the in-house pcl.coupling_matrix formula matches NaMaster's raw get_coupling_matrix() to floating-point round-off; (b) decoupled_bandpowers.max_rel_diff <= 1e-10 (measured 1.54e-12), i.e. pcl.decouple matches wsp.decouple_cell(); (c) s6_effective_multipole_vs_namaster shows every 8-wide band's max_rel_err_vs_namaster > 0.1 (worst band 2-9 measured 1.177, best band 90-95 measured 0.232), quantifying the S6 shortcut's error in NaMaster-verified terms rather than against the in-house exact result alone.
provenance: pipelines/namaster_proof/blind_test/pcl.py (honest MASTER estimator, unchanged), variants2.py (S6 shortcut, unchanged) - this cross-check reads both, modifies neither
